candidates.name: OGC API - Tiles Standard
verified_facts: OGC API - Tiles defines Web API building blocks for retrieving geospatial information as tiles.
The standard can carry different tiled information forms including vector features, coverages, maps and imagery.
semantic_limits: Tiled access, tile level or tile boundaries do not by themselves establish terrain measurement accuracy, source survey lineage or HMLR legal-boundary precision.

candidates.name: OGC SensorThings API Standard
verified_facts: SensorThings provides a geospatially enabled Web interface for IoT devices, observations, metadata and applications.
Its Sensing model standardizes access to observations from heterogeneous sensor systems.
semantic_limits: A standards-compliant observation endpoint does not certify the sensor's vertical accuracy, datum, sampling method or parcel identity; those remain separate provenance requirements.
